exposure: COVID-19 period of delivery (pre-pandemic vs. pandemic)
cohort: The study included 321 mothers and their newborns whose electronic records were reviewed after discharge between March 2019 and March 2021.
finding: Exclusive breastfeeding during hospitalization was significantly influenced by delivery method and maternal parity, with a notable decline observed during the COVID-19 pandemic period.
mod_finding: Vaginal births were strongly associated with higher exclusive breastfeeding rates compared to other modes of delivery.
